items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Eight vulnerabilities are rated Critical, with the highest CVSS score of 9.6.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Part of APSB26-73, this critical vulnerability has a CVSS score of 9.6 and allows for unrestricted file upload.

items.title: Improper Output Encoding vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Addressed in APSB26-73, this critical vulnerability has a CVSS score of 9.1.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical stored XSS vulnerability, with a CVSS of 8.7, affects standard Adobe Commerce stores and is part of APSB26-73.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce (Unauthenticated)
items.summary: A critical vulnerability (CVSS 8.6) in APSB26-73 that requires no authentication and allows an attacker to bypass security features.

items.title: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: This flaw allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical (CVSS 9.8) unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, which can lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin fixes 15 CVEs, including critical issues like CVE-2026-34686 (Stored XSS leading to arbitrary code execution) and CVE-2026-34653 (Path Traversal leading to arbitrary file system write).

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to arbitrary code execution
items.summary: Part of APSB26-49, this critical vulnerability has a CVSS of 8.7 and can lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Path Traversal leading to arbitrary file system write
items.summary: Addressed in APSB26-49, this critical vulnerability has a CVSS of 8.7 and can result in arbitrary file system writes.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, execute unauthorized malicious code, and gain unauthorized access to store data.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Full System Takeover
items.summary: A critical vulnerability fixed in APSB26-05 that allows attackers to execute code remotely, leading to a full system takeover.

items.title: Improper Access Control leading to Data Leak
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-05, allows bypassing security filters to access restricted information.

items.title: Stored XSS leading to Admin Hijacking
items.summary: A critical stored XSS vulnerability in APSB26-05 where malicious scripts can escalate user privileges and hijack admin sessions.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento's REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered this critical flaw that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any Magento or Adobe Commerce store using a polyglot technique to bypass validation.
